Saari 7 gallery images product page par render ho rahi hain. Summary:

**Root cause:** `Image::attachPath()` (app/Models/Image.php) jab koi image already kisi dusre product se attached ho, toh woh duplicate `Image` row banane ki koshish karta tha — lekin `images.filename` par unique constraint hai → `Duplicate entry` Integrity error → log mein warning, kuch attach nahi hota.

**Fix:** `attachPath()` ab aise case mein image ki **independent copy** banata hai (naya unique filename, file `uploads/Y/m` mein copy), phir product ko attach karta hai. Saath hi `existing === null` wala broken path bhi theek kiya (createFromPath se double-insert ho raha tha).

**Verification:**
- Tinker test: image attached to Category 65 → product 1 copy bani (id 841, file exists)
- Baaki 6 images (products 70/74 se) bhi product 1 mein attach — independent copies (id 842-847)
- Product 1 gallery ab 8 images, sab URLs 200, product page par render

# Customizing opencode

opencode validates its own config strictly and refuses to start when a field
is wrong. The shapes below cover the common surface area, but they are a
**summary, not the source of truth**.

## Full schema reference

The authoritative list of every config option — with field types, enums,
defaults, and descriptions — lives in the published JSON Schema:

**<https://opencode.ai/config.json>**

If a field is not documented in this skill, or you need to confirm an exact
shape before writing config, **fetch that URL and read the schema directly**
rather than guessing. opencode hard-fails on invalid config, so the cost of a
wrong shape is a broken startup.

Independently, every `opencode.json` should declare
`"$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json"` so the user's editor catches
mistakes as they type.

## Applying changes

Config is loaded once when opencode starts and is not hot-reloaded. After
saving changes to `opencode.json`, an agent file, a skill, a plugin, or any
other config-time file, **tell the user to quit and restart opencode** for
the changes to take effect. The running session will keep using the
already-loaded config until then.

## Where files live

| Scope                         | Path                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Project config                | `./opencode.json`, `./opencode.jsonc`, or `.opencode/opencode.json` (opencode walks up from the cwd to the worktree root) |
| Global config                 | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` (NOT `~/.opencode/`)                                                                   |
| Project agents                | `.opencode/agent/<name>.md` or `.opencode/agents/<name>.md`                                                               |
| Global agents                 | `~/.config/opencode/agent(s)/<name>.md`                                                                                   |
| Project commands              | `.opencode/command/<name>.md` or `.opencode/commands/<name>.md`                                                           |
| Global commands               | `~/.config/opencode/command(s)/<name>.md`                                                                                 |
| Project skills                | `.opencode/skill(s)/<name>/SKILL.md`                                                                                      |
| Global skills                 | `~/.config/opencode/skill(s)/<name>/SKILL.md`

Ho gaya — ab auto-save kisi bhi AI tool ke saath kaam karta hai. Total setup:

**1. `chat-saver.php`** — core function `save_chat()` + CLI mode
```bash
php chat-saver.php <chat.json> [dir] [prefix] [meta.json]
```

**2. `.opencode/plugins/chat-saver.ts`** — opencode plugin: har exchange ke baad full chat auto-save (JSON + markdown, date-time stamp ke saath `chat-logs/` me)

**3. `chat-watcher.mjs`** — generic watcher, kisi bhi AI tool ke transcript ke liye (Gemini CLI, Codex, Aider, Claude Code export, Cursor export, etc.):
```bash
node chat-watcher.mjs <transcript-file-or-dir> [output-dir] [prefix]
node chat-watcher.mjs --once <file> [output-dir] [prefix]   # ek baar save
```
- JSON, JSONL, aur markdown (`**User:**`, `### 1. User`) teeno formats detect karta hai
- File badalte hi 2s debounce ke baad auto-save
- `CHAT_WATCH_DIR` / `CHAT_OUTPUT_DIR` / `CHAT_PREFIX` env vars se bhi set ho sakta hai
- Tested: teeno formats correctly save hue

Note: opencode plugin load hone ke liye opencode **restart** karna hoga. Watcher naye terminal me `node chat-watcher.mjs <path>` chalao — wo live watch karega.
